name: Duhamel integral
domain: 车辆轨道结构与数值方法

complete_examples.text: The response of fastener points in the slab track-subgrade system can be calculated by the Duhamel integral.

The dynamic response of the track-tunnel system can be expressed by Duhamel integral: X(x, y, z, t) = ∮∮∮ Ω ∫t h(x, y, z, t −τ, ξ, η, ζ)F(τ)dτdV (16) in which h(⋅) is the Green function of the track-tunnel system; Ω is the integral field of the system; F(τ) denotes the impulse load of the track-tunnel system.
